understanding: Modem control is a sideband flow_control utility to an external modem peer, separate from serial data. This collateral provides one bidirectional agent that drives the four DUT status inputs and observes the two DUT control outputs, reusing wb_clk_i and wb_rst_i base and spec_rtl_relation RTL names, leaving scoreboard, tests and register mirrors to later phases.
actions: Create single utility agent collateral_modem_control_if owning rts_pad_o, dtr_pad_o, cts_pad_i, dsr_pad_i, ri_pad_i and dcd_pad_i per spec_rtl_relation identity map
Configure drive ownership for DUT inputs cts_pad_i, dsr_pad_i, ri_pad_i and dcd_pad_i with template drive_reset_values defaults
Configure observe-only for DUT outputs rts_pad_o and dtr_pad_o without driving
Bind agent to external modem peer as sideband flow_control with empty protocol requiring no additional protocol configuration
Integrate with existing wb_clk_i and wb_rst_i base without adding clock, reset or other-interface collateral
completion: Ownership declared for all six modem ports with drive for cts_pad_i, dsr_pad_i, ri_pad_i, dcd_pad_i and observe for rts_pad_o, dtr_pad_o
Agent bound to external modem peer as sideband flow_control with no protocol configuration required
No tie-offs on active agent ports and no other interfaces, sequences, tests or register mirrors implemented
